senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to cave out; to arch,] to bury.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:26">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>הנראה מי קוֹבֵר את מי</he> (Ms. M. <he>הא נראה</he>) we shall see, which will cover which (which will die first).
<cite ref="Sotah 14a:4">Sot. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה ק׳ … קְבוֹר מתים</he> the Lord buried the dead, … thou, too, bury the dead (consider attending to the dead a religious duty).
<cite ref="Niddah 24b:56">Nidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>קובר מתים הייתי</he> I used to be a grave-digger.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 15b:3-12">B. Bath. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>לא … לִקְבּוֹר וכ׳</he> he had no place where to bury Sarah; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6">Ex. R. s. 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 12:9">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. XII</cite> <he>קָבְרֵנִי תחלה וכ׳</he> first bury me in the valley, and then collect my bones.
<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 12:11">Ib.</cite> <he>קִבְרוּ אותי תחת וכ׳</he> bury me at the feet of my father.

<cite ref="Shabbat 114a:9">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תִּקְבְּרוּנִי לא וכ׳</he> bury me neither in white clothes nor in black &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קָבוּר</he>; f. <cite ref="S00042"><he>קְבוּרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:15">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הק׳ בא״י כאילו ק׳ וכ׳</he> he that is buried in Palestine is as though buried under the altar.
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:7">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>שאני ק׳ במחצלת וכ׳</he> for I am buried in a reed mat.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:12">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:10">Koh. VIII, 10</cite>) <he>קְבוּרִים ממש וכ׳</he> it really means buried things, for even hidden things were discovered by them, v. <cite ref="S00092"><he>קָבַץ</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47a:7">Snh. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נספד ולא נ׳</he> if a body has been neither lamented over (v. <cite ref="O01315"><he>סָפַד</he></cite>) nor buried.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47b:11">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יִקָּבֵר בו וכ׳</he> he must never be buried in that place; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to bury (one after the other). Ib. 113ᵃ היה מְקַבֵּר והולך וכ׳ he successively buried (his children) beginning with Abiham &c.
